name: obsidian-plugin-template
description: A minimal template for Obsidian plugins using Bun
author: Mark Ayers

scripts.dev: bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --watch
scripts.build: bun run check && bun build src/main.ts --outdir . --format cjs --external obsidian --external electron --minify
scripts.deploy: echo 'Update this path: cp main.js manifest.json ~/path/to/vault/.obsidian/plugins/your-plugin/'
